As their children grew up, they became the blue blood loyal Clinton era democrats, who inturn instilled their values to their children, the millennials. The difference between the hippies of the sixties and the extreme liberals of today though is the hippies had been exposed and raised on old fashioned values. Their grandchildren have not, to the millennials it seems perfectly logically based on the ideology taught to them to demand these services from society.

The second factor: outside communist groups. Don't laugh, you can see its ties in public sector unions and nonprofit programs.
